title: Brand facts
description: site/data/brands.json: what the Instagram Graph API told us about each handle, for the card. Written by npm run watch and npm run brands.

bio.description: First 160 characters; emails and phone numbers removed.

picture.description: profile_picture_url from the newest Graph read, only while that read is under 7 days old and the url's own expiry (oe) has not passed; else null and the site draws the brand's initial. Never copied off Meta's servers (platform terms).

picture_at.description: When the Graph read that gave picture happened (ISO); present whenever picture is a Meta url.

source_id.description: The data/sources.json id, on records built from a source with no Graph read.

source_only.description: True when the record comes from sources.json alone: handle is a card key, picture and followers are empty.

bio_source.description: The brand website the bio was read from when the Graph read gave none (npm run brands:deepen).

last_dated_post_seen.description: Latest event date (YYYY-MM-DD) we hold for the handle.
